newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end stronger, Nyk to set trend.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end stronger, Nyk to set trend.

text.p: 1608 GMT - Portuguese shares and futures on the PSI20 index of 20 leading stocks ended stronger and futures on Portugal Telecom closed weaker, accompanying the fall of the stock in the cash market. Dealers said the rise of the Lisbon market accompanied the trend elsewhere in Europe, except Paris. The stronger dollar also helped Portuguese stocks. Dealers said the trend on Lisbon bourse tomorrow would depend on the close of New York today.

* "The Lisbon market closed with room to rise further, but the trend tomorrow will depend on the close of New York today. The New York market has been volatile as the bond market is seeking direction," one operator said.
